high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a social media post from the Instagram Reels section. The post features an animated depiction of a deity with a blue complexion, multiple arms, and a fierce expression. The deity has a prominent forehead with a third eye and is surrounded by a glowing aura. The background includes a dramatic scene with a waterfall cascading down a rocky cliff, and there are fiery elements on either side, adding to the intense and mystical atmosphere. The text overlay on the image reads: "Kaal Bhairava is the chief among the eight Bhairavs.
